description: QMA 2-local Hamiltonian, sealed as exact rational Jordan exclusions on the UUM-8D torus: given ZZ terms and a presented computational configuration, return the exact energy energy_num/energy_den and WIN. constraints are i,j,jnum,jden;... (sites i,j with coupling jnum/jden), config is s0,s1,... bits. The presented configuration is evaluated exactly; no ground state is searched. Same law as math_court domain qma_2local and verify_vqe_energy. Floats refused (REFUSED_FLOAT).

config.description: computational bits s0,s1,... each 0 or 1, one per site, e.g. 0,1

constraints.description: ZZ terms i,j,jnum,jden;... e.g. 0,1,1,1 (sites 0 and 1, coupling 1/1)

name: execute_2local_hamiltonian
